updates.title: CVE-2026-83711: Azure AD B2C Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
updates.summary: Microsoft Azure Active Directory B2C contains an authorization bypass vulnerability allowing unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network through user-controlled key manipulation. This affects identity authentication flows and requires immediate patching to prevent account takeover and privilege escalation attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70352: Azure AI Language Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Azure AI Language services lack proper authentication controls for critical functions, allowing unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. This vulnerability could enable attackers to gain administrative access to AI services and potentially compromise sensitive data processing workflows.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70178: Microsoft Fabric Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Microsoft Fabric suffers from missing authorization controls that permit authenticated attackers to elevate their privileges across the network. Organizations using Fabric for data analytics and governance should apply patches to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra: Enhanced sAMAccountName Support for Domain Services
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Domain Services now supports synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute in Entra ID, now in public preview. This enhancement improves hybrid identity management by enabling more consistent account naming conventions between on-premises and cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Purview DLP policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365 locations. This expands DLP capabilities across hybrid cloud environments and third-party SaaS platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled without making actual changes, allowing admins to validate policy behavior before enforcement. This reduces the risk of mis-labeling and provides insights into policy performance through the new Insights tab.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Default Protection Controls for Exchange Classification Failures
updates.summary: Admins can now create DLP policies in Exchange Online that respond to specific classification or text extraction failure types such as timeouts and throttling errors, rather than applying one blanket policy. This granular control improves DLP responsiveness and reduces false positives when content classification encounters errors.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management Connector Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Microsoft Rights Management (RMS) connector is transitioning from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving security posture. Admins will configure their own Entra app registration and certificate using new PowerShell cmdlets for the connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and file classification integrations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability and Policy Management Enhancements
updates.summary: Purview is expanding auto-labeling capabilities to support larger SharePoint scopes, improving policy management flexibility, and providing richer visibility into auto-labeling activity across the organization. These enhancements enable enterprises to manage labeling policies at scale while maintaining visibility and control.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new device health dashboard for Endpoint DLP allows admins to monitor health status across all managed devices and identify systems not ready to receive policy updates. This provides visibility into DLP deployment readiness and helps ensure consistent policy enforcement across the endpoint fleet.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard provides MTTA/MTTD/MTTR SLA metrics for DLP alerts with customizable SLAs for high, medium, and low severity events, displaying trends and top sensitive information types exposed. Admins gain operational performance visibility to measure and optimize incident response times.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer for macOS
updates.summary: The Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer applications are now coming to macOS, bringing feature parity with Windows clients for labeling and viewing protected files. Advanced label-based protection features are not yet available on macOS but core functionality enables consistent compliance workflows across platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Azure PST Import
updates.summary: Azure PST Import enables migration of PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern with analysis and validation phases. This streamlines PST ingestion for organizations managing legacy mail data and archival migrations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Auto-Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes with eligible E5 licenses can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and scalable archive growth. This removes operational constraints that previously made mailboxes inoperative at the 1.5 TB threshold.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: The information protection scanner now exports labeling, classification, and protection actions to SQL tables, enabling administrators to create custom reports on the state of scanned repositories. This provides deeper visibility into classification and protection activities across scanned file systems and repositories.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now protect sensitive data in non-Microsoft applications including Box and Google Workspace using Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and Purview's classification engine. This extends sensitivity label enforcement to hybrid environments with third-party SaaS platforms.
